home.description: The server user's home folder, absolute. The app shows it as ~ in the permission cards and notifications (display only: the answer sends the rules as offered). Optional: older servers do not send it

agents.description: Every agent the server knows, as chat.status has them when the connection opens; only with the chat (chat.status brings each change)

free_only.description: The owner's "free only" switch (zf set-free-only), on: the agents run only on a subscription or free providers and models. The app words what it promises by it; only with the chat
